plugins.Author: Legends of the Game
plugins.Name: Time Memoria
plugins.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugins.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
plugins.Changelog: Fixes the oldest unfinished quest, which followed journal order and could offer a level 50 patch quest ahead of a level 1 one from launch. It now goes by patch, then by level. Societies at their final rank read as maxed rather than looking unfinished, and the clipboard export carries your completed class and job quests, your collectable counts, and your duty completions. The three counts are read from achievements, so each is sent with the time it was taken.
